# Bear Grid

Bear Grid is a Netherlands-based independent R&D consultancy founded in 2019.

Primary services:
- Technology and AI assessment
- R&D strategy
- Venture validation
- Innovation partnerships

Primary audiences:
- Deep-tech and AI founders
- Corporate innovation and R&D teams
- Investors and venture builders
- Universities, research organisations and public institutions

Canonical website: https://beargridsolutions.com

Important pages:
- Home: https://beargridsolutions.com/
- Investors: https://beargridsolutions.com/investors
- History: https://beargridsolutions.com/history
- Contact: https://beargridsolutions.com/contact
- Original Bear Grid platform archive: https://beargridsolutions.com/history/original-platform

The original Bear Grid company developed seismic sensing and signal-classification technology. The current company focuses on independent technology assessment, venture validation, innovation strategy and partnerships.
